excerpt.zh: 一个强大的信号从通常被认为是没有生命的星系中心发出，传向星系。没过多久，我们又收到了来自同一地点的信号传输。
excerpt.en: A powerful signal is bounced through the galaxy from the center, a place often thought to be empty of life. Shortly afterwards, we received a transmission from the very same location.

scope.zh: 银河中心的水晶帝国（Zer-Ayaki）：罕见出现、首次通讯、外交对话与三种委托（难民、重建、学者）。
scope.en: The Crystalline Empire (Zer-Ayaki) at the galactic centre: its rare appearance, first contact, the diplomacy dialogue and the three requests (refugees, reconstruction, a scholar).

label.zh: 之后任何时候打开外交对话：基础菜单
label.en: Any later diplomacy call: the base menu

label.zh: 若对方对你敌对：被赶走
选“有什么我们能帮上的吗”（任务可用时，权重10）：难民
选“有什么我们能帮上的吗”（权重10）：重建所需材料

title.en: Signal from the Center of the Galaxy

texts.zh: 一个强大的信号从通常被认为是没有生命的星系中心发出，传向星系。没过多久，我们又收到了来自同一地点的信号传输。
texts.en: A powerful signal is bounced through the galaxy from the center, a place often thought to be empty of life. Shortly afterwards, we received a transmission from the very same location.

texts.zh:
你好，星系的年轻人。

我们这些来自天堂中心的人再次离开了我们的庇护所，去看看你们这些住在外围的人必须为我们提供什么。希望你不会像在你之前的人那样试图给国家带来恐怖。
texts.en:
Hail, you who are still young and new to the galaxy.

We who come from the paradise of the center have once more left our sanctuary to see what you who live on the outer circles have to offer. Hopefully, you will not try to bring terror upon the empire like those who came before you.

label.en: Did they just cut the feed?

label.zh: 之后任何时候打开外交对话：基础菜单
label.en: Any later diplomacy call: the base menu

label.zh: 若对方对你敌对：被赶走

texts.zh: 你们还有什么想和我们讨论的吗？
texts.en: What else did you want to discuss with us?

texts.zh: 你现在站在晶态帝国外环舰队指挥官、内陆之守护者的面前。有什么是你想与我们讨论的吗？
texts.en: You stand in front of the Commander of the Outer Circle Armada of the Crystalline Empire, Protector of the Inner Lands. What is it you wish to discuss with us?

label.zh: 能不能告诉我更多关于你们家园的事？
label.en: Could you tell us more about your homeland?

responses.zh:
我们的家园如泡沫幻影，如果我们告诉你太多，将会给它带来末日。你们这些年轻的种族在被允许进入那座圣所之前还有很多需要学习的。

如果你们证明了自己的价值，有朝一日我们会将向你们揭示一切的真理。
responses.en:
Our homeland is like a dream, and if we were to tell you much more about it, that would be the end of it. You younger races still have much to learn before you can be allowed into the sanctum.

One day, if you prove worthy, we will be able to show you the truth of everything.

responses.zh:
我们长期以来观察着星系中的其他种族，并且我们在现在的邻居中看到了潜能。当我们收到信息，这些年轻种族中有一个就是我们在等待的那个，我们立刻就准备好了找到他们。

我们还不确定你们这些年轻种族中到底谁是我们正在寻找的，但是我们相信你们都有能力向我们证明自己。希望你们不要辜负我们的期望，而我们可以找到我们都能够接受的条件。
responses.en:
We have long watched over the other races in the galaxy, and we see potential in our current neighbors. When the messenger arrived with news that one of the younger races was the one we had waited for, we immediately prepared to track them down.

We are not certain which one of you younger races is the one we are looking for, yet, but we believe all of you can prove useful for us. Hopefully you will be able to live up to the expectations we have for you, and we can find terms that both of us will be happy with.

label.zh: 有什么你们在找的，或者需要我们帮忙的吗？
label.en: Is there anything you are looking for, or need our help with?

responses.zh: 没有，时机还没成熟。我们晚些时候再回来，希望那时我们向你能分享更多消息。
responses.en: No, the time for that is not now. Come back later, and hopefully we will be able to share more news with you.

label.zh: 有什么你们在找的，或者需要我们帮忙的吗？
label.en: Is there anything you are looking for, or need our help with?

label.zh: 选“有什么我们能帮上的吗”（任务可用时，权重10）：难民
选“有什么我们能帮上的吗”（权重10）：重建所需材料
选“有什么我们能帮上的吗”（权重10）：好奇的学者
label.en: Asking for tasks (weight 10): a curious scholar

texts.zh:
在我们社会中一些不守规矩的份子倡议在我们整个家园松绑一些规制，在首都造成了不小的骚乱。伟大的存在正计划把这些份子转移到外部世界，这样它们就不能对我们的边界和我们人民的和谐再构成任何威胁。

如果你们能接纳这些被流放者将会对我们有很大帮助。
texts.en:
Several unruly elements in our society are advocating for easing the restrictions on entering our homeland, causing quite a ruckus in the capital. The Great One is looking to move these elements into foreign lands, so they will no longer pose a threat to our borders or the harmony of our people.

If you would offer refuge for the displaced, that would be incredibly helpful to us.

label.zh: 我们会试着为他们找到容身之所的。
label.en: We will try to find some place for them to stay.

tooltips.zh: 在加来的10年内，我们可以在一个居住站上发起安置晶态难民决议。
tooltips.en: For the next 10 years we will be able to enact the Settle Crystalline Refugees decision on a Habitat.

label.zh: 我们的国土内没有空间了。
label.en: There is no room in our lands.

texts.zh:
很高兴听到这个消息。我希望他们可以在你们的国土上过得好，并成为你们帝国的佑护。

还有什么别的你们想讨论的吗？
texts.en:
That is good to hear. We hope they will thrive in your lands, and be a blessing for your empire.

Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?

label.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
label.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.

texts.zh:
我们很遗憾。那我们去别的地方为他们找容身之地了。

还有什么别的你们想讨论的吗？
texts.en:
We are sorry to hear that. We will look elsewhere for our people then.

Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?

label.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
label.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.

texts.zh:
我们最近在我们最大的城市之一发生了一长小型灾难，并迅速制造了难以言说的毁坏。为了将其修复如初，我们正寻找愿意向我们贡献材料的人，让我们开始重建工作。

当然，我们会慷慨地想愿意帮助我们的人支付酬劳。不仅如此，我们还可以派出一队工程师与你们的人民分享我们的一部分秘密。
texts.en:
We have recently seen a small calamity happen in one of our greatest cities, leaving untold destruction in its wake. To restore it to former glory, we are looking for people willing to send materials our way, so we can begin the reconstruction.

We will, of course, pay quite handsomely to anyone willing to help us out. Not only that, but we can send a team of engineers to share some of our secrets with your people.

label.zh: 我们可以为你们的人民拨出一部分资源。
label.en: We will set aside some materials for your people.

tooltips.zh: 在加来的10年内，我们可以在一个居住站上发起晶态建设决议。
tooltips.en: For the next 10 years we will be able to enact the Crystalline Construction decision on a Habitat.

texts.zh:
我们很高兴知道你们愿意提供帮助。你们的礼物可以帮助数以百万计的泽阿亚基。

还有什么别的你们想讨论的吗？
texts.en:
We are happy to hear you are willing to help us out. Your gift will help millions of lost Zer-Ayaki.

Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?

label.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
label.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.

texts.zh:
我们很遗憾你们不愿意提供帮助。我们只能再去其他地方寻找帮助了。

还有什么别的你们想讨论的吗？
texts.en:
We are sorry to hear that you are not willing to help us out. We will look elsewhere for help, then.

Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?

label.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
label.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.

texts.zh: 一位我们的首席科学官对你们的帝国产生了浓厚的兴趣，虽然很难说你们到底能提供什么我们帝国所没有的。但无论如何，他们希望能宜居你们国家并向你们中最杰出的人学习。
texts.en: One of our foremost scientists has taken a particular interest in your empire, though it is hard to say what you could offer that we of the Empire could not. In any case, they seek to move to your country and learn from your best.

label.zh: 我们对他们的位置有所打算了。
label.en: We have a position in mind for them.

tooltips.zh: 泽阿亚基科学官将会迁移到[Root.GetName]。
tooltips.en: A Zer-Ayaki Scientist will move to [Root.GetName].

label.en: There are no positions available for them.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

texts.zh:
大好消息。希望他们可以对你们的帝国做出比在我们这更大的贡献。

还有什么别的你们想讨论的吗？
texts.en:
Great news. Hopefully they will prove to be more helpful for your empire than they were for ours.

Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?

label.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
label.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.

texts.zh:
那他们可得找点别的事情干了。

还有什么别的你们想讨论的吗？
texts.en:
They will simply have to find something else to occupy their mind then.

Was there anything else you wanted to discuss?

label.zh: 是的，我们还有别的事情。
label.en: Yes, there was something else we had in mind.

texts.zh: 再见，恐怖分子，我们和你们没有什么好谈的。
texts.en: Leave, terrorist, we have nothing more to say to you.

summary.text:
# 水晶帝国 / Crystalline Empire

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/central_crystal_events.txt, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

游戏开始时 on_game_start（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:18）触发隐藏事件 central.1（events/central_crystal_events.txt:9-28）：如果有玩家使用“虚空居民”起源，则 1% 几率设置全局标记 central_crystal_flag；之后 central.2（只触发一次，:30-97）在银河中心生成水晶帝国与两端虫洞（或使用已存在的出生点），并让所有玩家国家收到 central.5。
At game start a 1% roll (only when a human has a void-dweller origin) sets central_crystal_flag; central.2 then spawns the empire at the galactic centre and fires central.5 for every player.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. central.5 “银河中心的信号”：中心传来强信号，随后收到来自同处的通讯；确认后与水晶帝国建立通讯并触发 central.10。 The signal; communications are established.
2. central.10 “来电”：水晶帝国的司令向“年轻的”你问候。灭绝者政体（净化者 / 吞噬虫群 / 机械灭绝者）只有敌意选项；其余选项“你好，……”→ central.15（对方切断了视频）。 Friendly empires reach 15 ("did they just cut the feed?"); exterminator civics get hostile options only.
3. 以后每次打开外交对话（on_custom_diplomacy，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:739）→ central.19：对方对你不敌对时 central.20 “水晶帝国”（可问三类问题：他们的故乡、为何现在出现、是否需要帮助），否则 central.21 “滚开，恐怖分子”。 Later, the diplomacy action shows the base menu 20, or 21 when hostile.
4. 在 20 中选“有什么我们能帮上的吗？”（没有任务时）：设 7200 天任务标记并触发 on_crystalline_empire_task（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:4774-4780）：三选一（10/10/10）：
   - central.50 “难民”（需要至少一个太空栖息地）：接受 → 10 年内可对栖息地使用“安置水晶难民”决定（central.51）；拒绝 → 52。 Refugees: accept (decision on a Habitat for 10 years, 51) or refuse (52).
   - central.60 “秘密技术/重建”：提供材料 → 10 年内可对栖息地使用“水晶建设”决定（61）；拒绝 → 62。 Reconstruction help.
   - central.70 “好奇的科学家”：接受 → 一名 Zer-Ayaki 科学家搬到你的国家（71）；拒绝 → 72。 A scholar wants to move to you.
   每个结果页都问“还有别的吗？”：是 → 回到 20；否 → 结束。 Every result page offers to return to menu 20.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 三种委托互斥（权重各10）；每个委托自身的接受/拒绝互斥。 The three requests are exclusive; each has accept/refuse.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 难民委托要求拥有太空栖息地；水晶帝国对你敌对时只会给 21。 The refugee request needs a Habitat; hostile contact gets only 21.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：central.1-72 的触发、on_action 与委托事件。
- 更正 Corrections：五个独立故事（2、19、50、60、70）并为一个，菜单 20 作为共享枢纽。 Five stories merged around the shared menu 20.
